verifications.claim: Submitting valid onboarding for Atlas shows a completion state with the submitted workspace and both notes counted.
verifications.evidence: After Create workspace, the trace recorded both Atlas notes filled and “2 notes ready” (step 10); the completion screen then visibly showed “Atlas is ready with 2 notes” (step 11).

verifications.claim: Clicking Open my board opens a usable board carrying the submitted onboarding data.
verifications.evidence: Open my board was clicked (step 11), but the subsequent recorded result confirms a board error page rather than a usable board with the submitted data (step 12).

verifications.claim: Submitting empty required profile fields or an empty-only notes step shows visible validation errors and keeps the wizard in place.
verifications.evidence: An empty Step 1 submission visibly showed workspace, email, and display-name required errors while remaining on Step 1 (step 26); an empty notes submission visibly showed “Add at least one note to get started” and remained on Step 3 (step 24).

verifications.claim: Previously entered profile and planning selections persist when navigating backward through the wizard.
verifications.evidence: After returning from Step 3, Step 2 still showed Personal selected and Sunday as the week start (step 34), and Step 1 later visibly retained Plan, user@example.com, and Alex (step 35).

verifications.claim: Removing note 1 removes Alpha while preserving Beta.

verifications.claim: Daily limits outside 1–20 are rejected with the stated error and do not advance from Step 2.
verifications.evidence: Submitting 21 left the value visible and the next observation showed Step 3, demonstrating that the out-of-range upper value advanced (steps 64–65); although 0 correctly remained on Step 2 with “Daily limit must be between 1 and 20” (steps 67–68), both boundaries were required to be rejected.
